context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 dense contact sheets, each 96 frames (8 columns x 12 rows, chronological) of one Tesla Sentry clip LABELLED as containing NO contact (a near-miss or quiet event). For EACH, decide whether the car is actually physically touched anywhere in the clip. Output one line per image:
<name>: EVIDENCE=direct|indirect|indeterminate|none; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 15 words>
direct = a touch is visibly happening; indirect = aftermath/motion implies a touch; none = clearly nothing touches; indeterminate = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: rd-1eqotqc-4-4-magnitude-earthquake-in-pasadena-ca
Image 2: rd-g1dq6a-sentry-mode-activated-beesy-intruder
Image 3: rd-mpm6my-my-favorite-sentry-event-i-ve-captured
Image 4: yt-3zve4fsafyc
Image 5: yt-iv4q0tiawa4
response:

rd-g1dq6a-sentry-mode-activated-beesy-intruder: EVIDENCE=indeterminate; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Insect approaches lens closely; hovering versus actual contact cannot be resolved.
rd-mpm6my-my-favorite-sentry-event-i-ve-captured: EVIDENCE=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Elephants and people cross at a visible distance from the recording car.
